move.attributionBasis: The unlabeled captions show Dillahunty interrupting Knechtle by rejecting Knechtle's attribution of a desire for judgment to him, after which he states this objection in his characteristic first-person argumentative voice.

responseComponents.text: A system that can forgive a murderer while eternally punishing victims does not guarantee proportionate justice and therefore challenges the claimed coherence of divine love and wrath.

move.proposition: Christian salvation and eternal punishment can allow a forgiven murderer to enter heaven while victims enter hell, so the system does not guarantee justice and intensifies the moral tension in God's character.
